title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Dependency Allowance Counted in a Waiting-Week Value with Earnings
content:
For a waiting-week value on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the part of the dependency allowance that counts follows the week's earnings and hours, the hours measured against the hours base of the waiting-week value.

| Week's earnings | Week's hours | Allowance counted |
|---|---|---|
| Above the disregard | At least 0.25 of the hours base (the quarter fraction) | The allowance times the hours base less the week's hours, divided by the hours base, rounded to the cent (the allowance in proportion to the unworked hours) |
| Above the disregard | Below 0.25 of the hours base | Three quarters (0.75) of the allowance, rounded to the cent |
| Not above the disregard | Any | The allowance in full |

The counted allowance is the allowance added to the weekly benefit amount before both deductions are subtracted.

## Hypothetical cases (allowance 15.00, hours base 32, so a quarter line of 8.0 hours)

| Earnings against the disregard | Hours | Allowance counted |
|---|---|---|
| Above | 12.0 | 15.00 times 20.0, divided by 32: 9.38 |
| Above | 8.0 | 15.00 times 24.0, divided by 32: 11.25 |
| Above | 6.0 | 11.25 (three quarters) |
| Not above | 12.0 | 15.00 |
